text: My husband and I had the true honor of having Heather not only paint our wedding, but literally make our day! Heather was a sweetheart from day 1 of talking all the way up to our wedding day. She kept us super informed along the way and really let us help guide decisions for our painting. Heather is one of the most talented people I have ever seen, she is absolutely AMAZING at what she does. It's one thing to be an amazing painter, but to be such a people person and to make clients feel so comfortable is truly special. Our guests loved her being there, it is such an added and new experience for people at weddings. This is such a new idea for weddings, you have to join in on this! It is the best experience for the guests and you get a lifelong piece for your home! I can't say enough amazing things about Heather! We loved our entire experience and she brought our wedding to life, now with a memory to last forever!! Thanks Heather!

owner_reply.text: Callie, thank you so much for having me be apart of your wedding.  You had a beautiful venue and you guys looked amazing. It was an honor! Thank you!❤️🎨
